$comment: 听力训练营 L14（P-L2）。脚本 100% 原创；阶段二 · Part 4 主旨三选一（5 段，引入相似话题干扰：两段都讲出行，一段讲带什么一段讲票价）+ Part 2 笔记填空（一段独白 5 空，首次加入姓名拼读 P-A-R-K-E-R 与地名拼读 M-I-L-F-O-R-D，朗读器按连字符逐字母拆读）。词汇 ≥95% 落在 KET A2 词表，超出的词进 warmup。语速 0.9x。
title: Travel Plans
intro: 五段都和出门有关，但每段讲的重点不一样：带什么、票多少钱、去哪儿、怎么去、车晚点。再听一段春游通知，第一次要把人名和地名一个字母一个字母拼出来。

sections.intro: 听一段短话，选出说话的人在讲什么。

script.text: Before our trip on Thursday, listen carefully. Everyone needs a packed lunch, a bottle of water and a hat, because we'll be outside all day.
You don't need any money, the school is paying. And please don't bring phones or games.

questions.q: What is the teacher talking about?
options: what to bring on the trip
questions.explain: needs a packed lunch, a bottle of water and a hat / don't bring phones——整段在说带什么。钱只说了一句「不用带」，出发时间根本没提。

sections.intro: 听一段短对话，选出他们在讲什么。

script.text: Mum, how much is the train to the city? I want to go with Jack on Saturday.
A return ticket is twelve pounds, but if you go after ten o'clock it's only eight.
Eight pounds is fine. Can I use my pocket money?
Yes, but buy the ticket online, it's cheaper than at the station.

questions.q: What are Tom and his mum talking about?
options: where to sit on the train
questions.explain: how much is the train / twelve pounds / only eight / cheaper——一直在说票价。ten o'clock 只是「几点之后更便宜」的条件，不是在讨论时间。

sections.intro: 听一段短话，选出说话的人在讲什么。

script.text: Every summer we go to the beach, but this year we're going to a farm in the hills. My dad's friend has horses there.
I can ride every morning and help with the animals. I think it will be much better than the beach.

questions.q: What is the girl talking about?
options: where her family is going this summer
what she will wear on holiday
questions.explain: this year we're going to a farm——在说今年去哪儿。beach 是往年的地方，用来对比；怎么去和穿什么都没说。

sections.intro: 听一段短对话，选出他们在讲什么。

script.text: Sam, shall we take the bus or the train to the museum tomorrow?
The train is faster, only twenty minutes. The bus takes an hour.
But the bus stops right outside the museum. The station is a long walk away.
OK, let's take the bus, then. We can read on the way.

questions.q: What are Jack and Sam talking about?
options: how to get to the museum
where to stay in the city
what to see in the museum
questions.explain: the bus or the train / faster / stops right outside / let's take the bus——在选怎么去。博物馆只是目的地，看什么和住哪儿都没讨论。

sections.intro: 听一段短话，选出说话的人在讲什么。

script.text: This is a message for people waiting for the quarter past ten train to the city. The train is running twenty minutes late.
It will now leave from platform four, not platform two. We are sorry for the wait.

questions.q: What is the man telling the people at the station?
options: The train is not running today.
questions.explain: running twenty minutes late / sorry for the wait——车晚点了。它还在开（会从 4 号站台走），没说满员。

sections.intro: 听一段春游通知，把笔记补全。人名和地名会一个字母一个字母拼出来，拼写要完全正确。

script.text: Good morning, Class Six. Here is everything you need to know about our trip next week.
We are going to Milford Castle. Milford is spelled M-I-L-F-O-R-D. It's an old castle by a river, about an hour away.
The coach leaves the school gate at quarter to nine, so be here by half past eight. If you are late, the coach will not wait.
The trip costs twelve pounds. That's for the coach and the ticket to the castle. It does not pay for lunch, so bring a packed lunch.
Mrs Parker is coming with us. That's P-A-R-K-E-R. She will look after the girls, and I will look after the boys.
We will be back at school at half past four, not four o'clock, so tell your parents. Any questions? No? Great.

questions.q: Class Six Trip — Going to: ______ Castle
questions.explain: Milford is spelled M-I-L-F-O-R-D，逐字母拼出来，照抄就行，拼错一个字母都不算。
leaves at quarter to nine = 8:45。half past eight 是到校时间。
the trip costs twelve pounds = 12，包含大巴和城堡门票。
Mrs Parker … That's P-A-R-K-E-R。听拼读写名字，P-A-R-K-E-R。
back at school at half past four, not four o'clock = 4:30。four o'clock 被 not 否定。
